Class CliHand

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.cli.cliElements.CliElement
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.cli.cliElements.CliHand
public class CliHand extends CliElement
Represents a CLI hand element that displays a component in the player's hand.

    • CliHand

      public CliHand(Component component)
      Creates a new CLI hand element with the given component. If the component is null, it will represent an empty hand.
      Parameters:
      component - The component to be displayed in the hand, or null for an empty hand

    • CliHand

      public CliHand()
      Default constructor for an empty CLI hand. Initializes the hand without any component.

  • Method Details

      public void setHand(Component lastComponent)
      Sets the hand to display the given component. If the component is null, it clears the hand.
      Parameters:
      lastComponent - The component to be displayed in the hand, or null to clear the hand

    • clearHand

      public void clearHand()
